prompts.school: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D side-scrolling beat-em-up environment sprite atlas, 3 columns by 3 rows, 9 isolated objects. Create a NEW atlas using the supplied stage image only as a style reference. Painted ink outlines, crisp hand-painted material detail, believable school furniture, side-on 3/4 front view matching the reference's camera, consistent light from upper left. Each object centered within its own equal square cell; generous transparent padding, all silhouette and feet visible, never cross cell boundaries. No text, labels, grid lines, floor, backdrop, UI, people, shadows outside the object, or duplicated objects. Actual transparent alpha background. Each object must be a single self-contained game prop. 1536x1536 square atlas. School corridor and canteen palette: dark green enamel, warm orange details, aged cream paint, honey wood. Row 1 left to right: green four-door locker bank; broad wooden school bench on green steel legs; cluster of three school recycling bins. Row 2: tall leafy plant in square orange ceramic planter; green rolling canteen serving cart with trays and closed food covers; glass trophy display cabinet with orange wood frame. Row 3: green framed wall noticeboard with pinned paper shapes; orderly stack of four green school chairs; small broad folded cafeteria service barrier with orange steel frame. Preserve realistic object proportions, no miniature toys.

prompts.guard_actions: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW production sprite sheet expanding the exact robot in the reference, preserve its helmet, proportions, armor panels, colors and painted ink style. Reference is only this NPC, no player character. 4 columns by 4 rows, exactly 16 full-body isolated poses, all facing right, consistent anatomy and a shared floor baseline within each row. Large transparent gutters; no limbs cross cells or touch another figure. Draw genuinely different actions, not translated duplicates. True transparent alpha, no floor, no labels, no motion trails, no graphic effects. 1536x1536 square. Row 1 from left: front knee lift preparing a kick; fully extended horizontal front kick with a planted support foot; kick leg retracting; upright recovery guard. Row 2: crouched windup for a low kick; wide sweeping low kick contact with extended leg; low kick recovery; crouched defensive guard. Row 3: both fists lifted for a heavy overhead strike; powerful downward hammerfist at shoulder height; recovering from hammerfist; standing armored block with raised forearms. Row 4: forward leaning dash preparation; long planted step into a shoulder rush; backward evasive body lean; short recovery shuffle into guard. The standing robot's head-to-foot height remains consistent; crouches bend the actual anatomy. Large readable limb silhouettes. Ivory and forest-green armor with small orange panels, narrow black visor.
